decisions.reason: As a technically enhanced desk system in the firm's core office furniture domain, it fits existing design, engineering and commercial knowledge well enough that the firm is likely to keep refining rather than withdraw it.
A chair family is very close to the firm's established competencies in premium seating, materials and configurable interiors, so absorptive capacity for improvement and market learning is strong.

Floor cushions extend existing material and interior-solution knowledge but sit somewhat more at the edge of the core furniture business, so the firm is likely to keep them only if they continue to support its broader room concept.

A soft upholstered sofa is highly related to the firm's established lounge and residential offer and benefits from its designer collaboration and craftsmanship base, making continuation more likely than exit.
A high standing table is close to the firm's workplace and conference capabilities and aligns with flexible contemporary office use, so the firm can plausibly learn from and further develop it.

Because the rug collection is comparatively distant from the firm's main knowledge base, the firm has weaker absorptive capacity to improve and scale it and is more likely to reallocate resources to core furniture lines.
